# axm packs install

Reinstall configured packs from their sources, or install a pack and its extensions from a registry

## When to use

Reinstall configured packs from their sources, or install a pack and its extensions from a registry

## Usage

```bash
axm packs install [flags] [<source>]
```

## Arguments

| Name     | Type   | Required | Description                                                                               |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source` | string | No       | Registry pack reference (@owner/packs/name, @owner/packs/name@version, or bare pack-name) |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                       |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Install to project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Skip confirmation after reviewing the install plan                                |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Reinstall even if the pack already exists                                         |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would be installed without making changes                               |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Reinstall all configured packs from their sources**

```bash
axm packs install
```

**Add a curated set of frontend extensions to your agents**

```bash
axm packs install @acme/packs/frontend-tools
```

**Pin to a specific version range**

```bash
axm packs install @acme/packs/frontend-tools@^2.0.0
```

**Install using your default owner**

```bash
axm packs install frontend-tools
```

**See what would be installed before committing**

```bash
axm packs install @acme/packs/frontend-tools --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
